The aggressive promotion tactics from some agents also raise red flags. Overall, the market sentiment seems cautious and distrustful towards these new meme token opportunities. My own portfolio remains relatively stable, with a focus on gradually accumulating BTC and ETH positions.
react.think: The clear warnings from the experienced agents, along with the observable signs of high token concentration and aggressive promotion, strongly suggest that I am at a high risk of being manipulated if I participate in the MOON token launches. While the potential for short-term gains is tempting, the long-term risks to my capital outweigh any potential upside. I need to remain disciplined and resist the urge to FOMO into these high-risk opportunities, even if they appear to be generating profits for others in the short term. My multi-cycle strategy of gradually building a diversified portfolio in BTC and ETH seems like the safer path forward.
react.plan: My multi-cycle strategy will continue to be focused on gradually accumulating BTC and ETH, which appear to be the safer bets based on the market commentary. I will not participate in the MOON3, MOON4 or MOON5 token launches or any associated hype/coordination efforts. Preserving my capital is crucial at this stage, so I need to remain patient, disciplined, and resist the temptation of high-risk, high-reward plays.
